_doc: The forward rule's registry (docs/governance/harbor-ro3-requirements-store.md, drydock RO-3 tranche 4). A delivery event of a listed type appended after the cutover that names no REQ or outcome is refused by `gz validate --catalog` (ruling 4; advisory until RO-5 tranche 4 made it fail-closed, operator 2026-10-28: "Fail-closed, legacy exempt (Recommended)": an event naming an OBPI or ADR id is frozen legacy and passes, any other names a REQ, an outcome or a held work package). Events before the cutover are legacy and never read or backfilled. Operator rulings of 2026-10-22: "All nine (Rec.)" for the types, "Timestamp in registry (Rec.)" for the cutover, set when tranche 4 landed. Shape: src/gzkit/schemas/catalog_delivery_events.json; read by gzkit/models/catalog.py.
